about: Camrose is a city in east-central Alberta, southeast of Edmonton in parkland farming country. A compact downtown, Augustana Campus of the University of Alberta, and regional retail serve surrounding counties. Highways 13 and 21 meet in a classic prairie service centre. About 19,000 people live in Camrose.
seoSummary: East-central Alberta parkland city—regional service hub with Augustana Campus southeast of Edmonton.
